items.q: Supportive treatment of NASH — what weight-loss target and exercise prescription are printed?
opts: Weight loss 10% over 6 months; exercise 30–45 min/day × 5 days/week
Weight loss 5% over 3 months; exercise 60 min/day × 7 days/week
Weight loss 15% over 12 months; exercise 20 min/day × 3 days/week
Weight loss 10% over 1 month; exercise 30 min × 2 days/week
items.exp: 'Weight loss : 10% over 6 months. Exercise : 30 – 45 minutes / day × 5 day / wk.' (Book p1032)

Judge the Vitamin E sub-bullets: I Improves NASH. II Its efficacy in cirrhosis is unknown. III Takes about 2 years to show effect.
opts: I and II true, III false

items.exp: 'improves NASH, unknown efficacy in cirrhosis' and 'takes ~2 years to show effect'. (Book p1032)

items.q: Saroglitazar (4 mg) works by which mechanism, per the book?
Match — 1) Pioglitazone 2) Oral semaglutide 3) Saroglitazar … A) GLP-1 RA B) PPAR-γ agonist (may be tried) C) Dual PPAR-α + γ agonist
items.exp: Pioglitazone PPAR-γ agonist (may be tried); Oral semaglutide GLP-1 RA (receptor agonist); Saroglitazar dual PPAR-α+γ. (Book p1032)
